name: Pembrokeshire (United Kingdom)
description: A blue field with a yellow cross throughout; at the centre a Tudor rose — white petals around a red-and-white quartered heart — within a green cinquefoil border.
history: Registered with the Flag Institute in 2015. The gold cross on blue draws on the arms of the de Clare earls of Pembroke; the Tudor rose recalls Henry VII's birth at Pembroke Castle.

features.symbolism: the Tudor dynasty, which sprang from Pembroke Castle
